mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,payload,attempts FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY')) AS pending, GREATEST(0,TRUNC(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-MIN(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY')) )))::bigint) AS oldest_seconds, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='DEAD') AS dead FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY','DEAD')

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','RETRY') THEN 1 END) AS pending, COALESCE(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','RETRY') THEN created_at END), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) AS oldestSeconds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='DEAD' THEN 1 END) AS dead FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY','DEAD')
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_event_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',attempts=attempts+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')

UPDATE catalog_event_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN attempts+1>=#{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'RETRY' END, attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
